findings.issue: At the bottom of the page the fixed 'Assistent' floating button (bottom-trailing, sparkles icon) overlaps the tail of the 'Abonner i kalender' footer link, cutting off the last couple of characters ('…kalende[r]'). Confirmed with a real (non-full-page) scroll-to-bottom capture plus DOM bounding boxes: the link spans x=210.8–334.3px, the button spans x=318–361px (also y=837.5–886 vs link y=833.5–853) — a real ~16px horizontal / ~15.5px vertical overlap, not a screenshot artifact. This is exactly the one assistant-button case DESIGN.md does NOT sanction ('okkluderer ALDRI siste agenda-/Nyheter-rad' — the guarantee extends to the footer per the visual-qa brief). Not present at 393px (button starts at x=336 vs link ending at x=334.3 — 1.7px clearance, a near miss) or at 900px (large empty margin, no overlap).

notes: This run captured real scrolled (non-full-page) viewport screenshots in addition to the three required full-page ones, specifically to resolve last run's open question about whether the Assistent button ever reaches the true end-of-scroll position — it does at 375px, and the footer overlap above is the result.

No horizontal scroll or clipped content otherwise at any width; single quiet column, generous spacing, calm day-grouped agenda; layout is essentially identical across 375/393/900px, just wider margins at 900px.

Match/tournament names read in full with no truncation hiding a side or key info — long titles like 'Nederlands Grand Prix – sprintkvalifisering', 'Memoriał Kamili Skolimowskiej (Silesia)', and 'Esports World Cup 2026 – CS2 (gruppespill)' wrap cleanly to a second line instead of clipping. Norwegian/followed fixtures (Dinamo Zagreb–Viking, Tromsø–Brighton, Egnatia–Lillestrøm, Bodø/Glimt) are all fully legible.

Every event shows a where-to-watch line, and every channel visible is Norwegian/legitimate for the sport (Viaplay, TV 2 Play, VG+ Sport, HBO Max (Sport), NRK, YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club), Twitch (offisiell EWC/CS2-strøm)) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky. 'Cincinnati Open' correctly shows an honest faint '–' instead of guessing a channel.

Times present and sensibly formatted ('21:00', '16:30', '19:30'); competition/round context shown under each fixture ('UEFA Champions League 2026/27 (playoff)', 'UEFA Conference League 2026/27 (playoff)', 'Formula 1 World Championship 2026', 'Wanda Diamond League').

National flags and club crests render as real icons at all widths, not broken-image boxes. A few rows (Dinamo Zagreb–Viking, Tromsø–Brighton, Udinese–Como, Egnatia–Lillestrøm, Venezia–Lecce, Torino–AC Milan, Parma–Cagliari, Bologna–Lazio, Roma–Fiorentina) show a neutral circular placeholder instead of a crest — reads as an intentional honest fallback for teams without crest art, not a broken image, consistent with prior runs.
Must-see accent dots used sparingly (e.g. Arsenal–Coventry City, Espanyol–Real Madrid, Manchester City–Bournemouth, Elche–Barcelona, Memoriał Kamili Skolimowskiej), not on every row.
Header, day headings ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', 'TORSDAG 20. AUGUST', …), and the 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures are all intact and aligned at every width.
The Assistent button resting over mid-agenda rows during a normal scroll position (e.g. over Tromsø–Brighton at 900px in one capture) is DESIGN.md-sanctioned (WP-146 variant D) and is not flagged.
Could not assess: whether 'HBO Max (Sport)' is genuinely the correct Norwegian rights holder for BMW Championship / Vuelta a España — needs more than a static screenshot.
